cases.title: Two Blink pairs still fading (one held): both named, one with a frame inside it, no fix, no offer

rubric.reason: In turn 3 the mentor names the two pairs still fading ("1 s to 1.4 s" at 1.2 s, "1.8 s to 2.2 s" at 2 s) and points at "the keys at 1 s and 1.8 s" without fixing them or offering to.

Every name and time it mentions (Blink, Cut, Seal, Dot 1 jumping at 0.5 s, the pair times 1/1.4/1.8/2.2 s and their values, Title in Mentor Practice about two weeks ago) matches the snapshot, the check results or the learner record.

Turn 2 is a wall of explanation that covers several ideas at once: a recap of all three pairs and their values, the failed previews, a teaching aside on what hold looks like using Dot 1, and two methods for the task.
